description: Tool to update an event type availability schedule in Calendly. Use when you need to change the timezone or availability rules for an event type. WARNING: Updating rules will overwrite all existing rules - retrieve existing rules first using GET /event_type_availability_schedules.

inputSchema.description: Request to update availability schedules for a specific Calendly event type.

availability_rule.description: Availability rule configuration containing timezone and rules for when the event type is available. WARNING: Rules will overwrite all existing rules.

rules.description: Array of availability rule objects that define when the event type is available. WARNING: This will overwrite all existing rules. To preserve existing rules, first retrieve them using GET /event_type_availability_schedules and then pass the modified rules.

items.description: Rule defining availability for a specific day or date.

date.description: Specific date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) when type is 'date'. Example: '2025-08-05'. Required when type is 'date'.
date.title: Date

intervals.description: Array of time intervals defining when the event type is available during the specified day or date. Empty array means no availability for that day.

items.description: Time interval defining when availability exists.

from.description: Start time of the availability interval in 24-hour format (HH:MM), e.g., '09:00'.
from.title: From

to.description: End time of the availability interval in 24-hour format (HH:MM), e.g., '17:00'.
to.title: To

items.title: TimeInterval

intervals.title: Intervals

type.description: The type of availability rule: 'wday' for weekday-based rules or 'date' for specific date rules.
type.title: Type

wday.description: Day of the week when type is 'wday'. Values: 'sunday', 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday'. Required when type is 'wday'.
wday.title: Wday

items.title: AvailabilityRule

rules.title: Rules

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the availability schedule (e.g., 'Europe/London', 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Calcutta').
timezone.title: Timezone

availability_rule.title: Availability Rule

availability_setting.description: Indicates how availability is determined. Valid values: 'host' or 'all'. Default: 'host'.
availability_setting.title: Availability Setting

event_type.description: URI of the event type whose availability schedule is to be updated. Must follow the pattern https://api.calendly.com/event_types/{uuid} and contain '/event_types/' in the path. Other Calendly URIs (e.g., user_availability_schedules, scheduling_links, users) are NOT valid for this field.
event_type.title: Event Type

user.description: URI of the user associated with the event type. Required when an admin or org owner is updating a specific user's schedule.
user.title: User
